clauses.text:
By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution and statutes of 
the United States of America, including the Emergency Petroleum Allocation 
A ct of 1973, as amended (15 U .S.C . 751 et se q .), Executive Order No. 12140 is 
hereby amended by deleting the first sentence in Sec. 1-105.
THE W HITE H O U SE, 
Septem ber 28, 1979.
